commits.subject: Update control mappings in consolidated rules (#37)

summary.headline: 1 added, 19 changed
glance: This update has **1 new entry**, **19 changed** (2 substantive, 12 minor, 0 editorial, 5 mapping-only).

added.name: Minimum Assessment Scope
added.text: The boundary of the assessment and FedRAMP Certification for the cloud service offering, which effectively defines the cloud service offering itself for the purposes of a FedRAMP Certification Package; anything that is not entirely included in the Minimum Assessment Scope is a third-party information resource.
fedramp_notes: 2026-10-31: Added to support the explanation in the rule.

changed.name: Public Service List
changed.text_before: Providers MUST publicly share a detailed list of specific services and their security categories that are included in the cloud service offering using clear feature or service names that align with standard public marketing materials; this list MUST be complete enough for a potential customer to determine which services are and are not included in the FedRAMP Minimum Assessment Scope without requesting access to underlying FedRAMP Certification Data.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST publicly share a detailed list of specific services and their security categories that are included in the cloud service offering using clear feature or service names that align with standard public marketing materials; this list MUST be complete enough for a potential customer to determine which services are and are not included in the FedRAMP Minimum Assessment Scope without requesting access to underlying FedRAMP Certification Data.
sentences: Linked defined terms: added `Minimum Assessment Scope`.

changed.name: Downgrading Certification Class
changed.text_before: Providers MUST apply for a new FedRAMP Certification to downgrade their Certification Class.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST apply for a new FedRAMP Certification to downgrade their Certification Class.

fields.label: Notes
fields.before:

fields.after:

sentences: Notes reworded (1 word removed, 1 word added).

changed.name: Upgrading Certification Class
changed.text_before: Providers MUST apply for a new FedRAMP Certification to upgrade their Certification Class; all applicable requirements MUST be met in advance.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST apply for a new FedRAMP Certification to upgrade their Certification Class; all applicable requirements to obtain the new FedRAMP Certification MUST be met in advance.

fields.label: Notes
fields.before:
Upgrade paths include moving from A to B, C, or D; B to C or D; and C to D.
The preferred path is to incrementally update the implementation and assurance commitments within the current Certification Class until the provider has met all requirements for the target Certification Class, then apply for the new Certification Class.
fields.after:
Upgrade paths include moving from A to B, C, or D; B to C or D; and C to D.
The preferred path is to incrementally update the implementation and assurance commitments within the current Certification Class until the provider has met all requirements for the target Certification Class, then apply for the new Certification Class.
All applicable CR26 requirements are based on the obtain deadlines in each CR26 ruleset when applying to obtain a new FedRAMP Certification, even if it is an upgrade. FedRAMP may make case-by-case exceptions based on individual circumstances and critical government need, however, so please contact FedRAMP for guidance when planning an upgrade in 2027.

fields.after: Providers MUST apply for a new FedRAMP Certification to upgrade their Certification Class; all applicable requirements to obtain the new FedRAMP Certification MUST be met in advance.

fedramp_notes: 2026-10-31: Updated wording and added a note to more explicitly clarify that upgrading is obtaining a new FedRAMP Certification.

changed.name: Certification Package
changed.text_before: Has meaning from 44 USC § 3607 (b)(8) given to "authorization package", which is "the essential information that can be used by an agency to determine whether to authorize the operation of an information system or the use of a designated set of common controls for all cloud computing products and services [certified] by FedRAMP."
changed.text_after: Has meaning from 44 USC § 3607 (b)(8) given to "authorization package", which is "the essential information that can be used by an agency to determine whether to authorize the operation of an information system or the use of a designated set of common controls for all cloud computing products and services [certified] by FedRAMP."

changed.name: FedRAMP Certification Report
changed.text_before: A report that is produced by FedRAMP documenting the results of a FedRAMP Certification assessment. This report is typically produced after the initial FedRAMP Certification assessment on the Program Certification Path and updated as necessary during ongoing FedRAMP Certification, but may be produced at any time by FedRAMP as part of ongoing FedRAMP Certification activities for any cloud service offering (such as corrective action). Cloud service offerings must include these reports in their FedRAMP Certification Package.
changed.text_after: A report that is produced by FedRAMP documenting the results of a FedRAMP Certification assessment. This report is typically produced after the initial FedRAMP Certification assessment on the Program Certification Path and updated as necessary during ongoing FedRAMP Certification, but may be produced at any time by FedRAMP as part of ongoing FedRAMP Certification activities for any cloud service offering (such as corrective action). Cloud service offerings must include these reports in their FedRAMP Certification Package.

changed.name: FedRAMP Certified
changed.text_before: The status of a cloud service offering that has received FedRAMP Certification and meets the legal requirement to be FedRAMP authorized.
changed.text_after: The status of a cloud service offering that has received FedRAMP Certification and meets the legal requirement to be FedRAMP authorized.

changed.name: Validation
changed.text_before: Confirmation through objective evidence that implemented security capabilities and related certification data are suitable for their intended FedRAMP Certification use and support the expected security outcomes for a cloud service offering.
changed.text_after: Confirmation through objective evidence that implemented security capabilities and related certification data are suitable for their intended FedRAMP Certification use and support the expected security outcomes for a cloud service offering.
